text: {"components": [{"type": "entity", "quote": "ComCom", "gist": "Federal Communications Commission"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "ElCom", "gist": "Federal Electricity Commission"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "La commission fédérale de la communication (ComCom) est l'autorité indépendante de régulation du marché des télécommunications et octroie les concessions.", "gist": "ComCom is the independent regulatory authority for the telecommunications market and grants concessions."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Composée de sept membres nommés par le Conseil fédéral, la commission est indépendante des autorités administratives et prend ses décisions en toute indépendance.", "gist": "The commission has seven members appointed by the Federal Council and operates independently of administrative authorities."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "L'ElCom est l'autorité fédérale indépendante de régulation dans le domaine de l'électricité.", "gist": "ElCom is the independent federal regulatory authority in the field of electricity."}]}
